record.bible_text: Then Shephatiah<WH08203> the son<WH01121> of Mattan<WH04977>, and Gedaliah<WH01436> the son<WH01121> of Pashur<WH06583>, and Jucal<WH03116> the son<WH01121> of Shelemiah<WH08018>, and Pashur<WH06583> the son<WH01121> of Malchiah<WH04441>, heard<WH08085><WTH8799> the words<WH01697> that Jeremiah<WH03414> had spoken<WH01696><WTH8764> unto all the people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, He that remaineth<WH03427><WTH8802> in this city<WH05892> shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, by the famine<WH07458>, and by the pestilence<WH01698>: but he that goeth forth<WH03318><WTH8802> to the Chaldeans<WH03778> shall live<WH02421><WTH8804>; for he shall have his life<WH05315> for a prey<WH07998>, and shall live<WH02421><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH02425><WTH8804>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, This city<WH05892> shall surely<WH05414><WTH8736> be given<WH05414><WTH8735> into the hand<WH03027> of the king<WH04428> of Babylon's<WH0894> army<WH02428>, which shall take<WH03920><WTH8804> it.

Therefore the princes<WH08269> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the king<WH04428>, We beseech thee, let this man<WH0376> be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>: for thus<WH03651> he weakeneth<WH07503><WTH8764> the hands<WH03027> of the men<WH0582> of war<WH04421> that remain<WH07604><WTH8737> in this city<WH05892>, and the hands<WH03027> of all the people<WH05971>, in speaking<WH01696><WTH8763> such words<WH01697> unto them: for this man<WH0376> seeketh<WH01875><WTH8802> not the welfare<WH07965> of this people<WH05971>, but the hurt<WH07451>. <RF>welfare: Heb. peace<Rf>

Then Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, he <FI>is<Fi> in your hand<WH03027>: for the king<WH04428> <FI>is<Fi> not <FI>he that<Fi> can<WH03201><WTH8799> do <FI>any<Fi> thing<WH01697> against you.

Then took<WH03947><WTH8799> they Jeremiah<WH03414>, and cast<WH07993><WTH8686> him into the dungeon<WH0953> of Malchiah<WH04441> the son<WH01121> of Hammelech<WH04428>, that <FI>was<Fi> in the court<WH02691> of the prison<WH04307>: and they let down<WH07971><WTH8762> Jeremiah<WH03414> with cords<WH02256>. And in the dungeon<WH0953> <FI>there was<Fi> no water<WH04325>, but mire<WH02916>: so Jeremiah<WH03414> sunk<WH02883><WTH8799> in the mire<WH02916>. <RF>of Hammelech: or, of the king<Rf>

Now when Ebedmelech<WH05663> the Ethiopian<WH03569>, one<WH0376> of the eunuchs<WH05631> which was in the king's<WH04428> house<WH01004>, heard<WH08085><WTH8799> that they had put<WH05414><WTH8804> Jeremiah<WH03414> in the dungeon<WH0953>; the king<WH04428> then sitting<WH03427><WTH8802> in the gate<WH08179> of Benjamin<WH01144>;
Ebedmelech<WH05663> went forth<WH03318><WTH8799> out of the king's<WH04428> house<WH01004>, and spake<WH01696><WTH8762> to the king<WH04428>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

My lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>, these men<WH0582> have done evil<WH07489><WTH8689> in all that they have done<WH06213><WTH8804> to Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030>, whom they have cast<WH07993><WTH8689> into the dungeon<WH0953>; and he is like to die<WH04191><WTH8799> for<WH06440> hunger<WH07458> in the place<WH08478> where he is: for <FI>there is<Fi> no more bread<WH03899> in the city<WH05892>. <RF>he is like...: Heb. he will die<Rf>

Then the king<WH04428> commanded<WH06680><WTH8762> Ebedmelech<WH05663> the Ethiopian<WH03569>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Take<WH03947><WTH8798> from hence thirty<WH07970> men<WH0582> with thee<WH03027>, and take up<WH05927><WTH8689> Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> out of the dungeon<WH0953>, before he die<WH04191><WTH8799>. <RF>with thee: Heb. in thine hand<Rf>

So Ebedmelech<WH05663> took<WH03947><WTH8799> the men<WH0582> with him<WH03027>, and went<WH0935><WTH8799> into the house<WH01004> of the king<WH04428> under the treasury<WH0214>, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> thence old<WH01094> cast clouts<WH05499> and old<WH01094> rotten rags<WH04418>, and let them down<WH07971><WTH8762> by cords<WH02256> into the dungeon<WH0953> to Jeremiah<WH03414>.

And Ebedmelech<WH05663> the Ethiopian<WH03569> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, Put<WH07760><WTH8798> now <FI>these<Fi> old<WH01094> cast clouts<WH05499> and rotten rags<WH04418> under thine armholes<WH0679><WH03027> under the cords<WH02256>. And Jeremiah<WH03414> did<WH06213><WTH8799> so.

So they drew up<WH04900><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414> with cords<WH02256>, and took him up<WH05927><WTH8686> out of the dungeon<WH0953>: and Jeremiah<WH03414> remained<WH03427><WTH8799> in the court<WH02691> of the prison<WH04307>.<CM>

Then Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> sent<WH07971><WTH8799>, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> unto him into the third<WH07992> entry<WH03996> that <FI>is<Fi> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>: and the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, I will ask<WH07592><WTH8802> thee a thing<WH01697>; hide<WH03582><WTH8762> nothing from me. <RF>third: or, principal<Rf>

Then Jeremiah<WH03414> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Zedekiah<WH06667>, If I declare<WH05046><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> unto thee, wilt thou not surely<WH04191><WTH8687> put me to death<WH04191><WTH8686>? and if I give thee counsel<WH03289><WTH8799>, wilt thou not hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> unto me?

So Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> sware<WH07650><WTH8735> secretly<WH05643> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, <FI>As<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, that made<WH06213><WTH8804> us this soul<WH05315>, I will not put thee to death<WH04191><WTH8686>, neither will I give<WH05414><WTH8799> thee into the hand<WH03027> of these men<WH0582> that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> thy life<WH05315>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414> unto Zedekiah<WH06667>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; If thou wilt assuredly<WH03318><WTH8800> go forth<WH03318><WTH8799> unto the king<WH04428> of Babylon's<WH0894> princes<WH08269>, then thy soul<WH05315> shall live<WH02421><WTH8804>, and this city<WH05892> shall not be burned<WH08313><WTH8735> with fire<WH0784>; and thou shalt live<WH02421><WTH8804>, and thine house<WH01004>:

But if thou wilt not go forth<WH03318><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428> of Babylon's<WH0894> princes<WH08269>, then shall this city<WH05892> be given<WH05414><WTH8738> into the hand<WH03027> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>, and they shall burn<WH08313><WTH8804> it with fire<WH0784>, and thou shalt not escape out<WH04422><WTH8735> of their hand<WH03027>.

And Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, I am afraid<WH01672><WTH8802> of the Jews<WH03064> that are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804> to the Chaldeans<WH03778>, lest they deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> me into their hand<WH03027>, and they mock<WH05953><WTH8694> me.

But Jeremiah<WH03414> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, They shall not deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>thee<Fi> . Obey<WH08085><WTH8798>, I beseech thee, the voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068>, which I speak<WH01696><WTH8802> unto thee: so it shall be well<WH03190><WTH8799> unto thee, and thy soul<WH05315> shall live<WH02421><WTH8799>.
But if thou refuse<WH03986> to go forth<WH03318><WTH8800>, this <FI>is<Fi> the word<WH01697> that the LORD<WH03068> hath shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> me:

And, behold, all the women<WH0802> that are left<WH07604><WTH8738> in the king<WH04428> of Judah's<WH03063> house<WH01004> <FI>shall be<Fi> brought forth<WH03318><WTH8716> to the king<WH04428> of Babylon's<WH0894> princes<WH08269>, and those <FI> women<Fi> shall say<WH0559><WTH8802>, Thy friends<WH0582><WH07965> have set thee on<WH05496><WTH8689>, and have prevailed<WH03201><WTH8804> against thee: thy feet<WH07272> are sunk<WH02883><WTH8717> in the mire<WH01206>, <FI>and<Fi> they are turned away<WH05472><WTH8738> back<WH0268>. <RF>Thy friends: Heb. Men of thy peace<Rf>

So they shall bring out<WH03318><WTH8688> all thy wives<WH0802> and thy children<WH01121> to the Chaldeans<WH03778>: and thou shalt not escape out<WH04422><WTH8735> of their hand<WH03027>, but shalt be taken<WH08610><WTH8735> by the hand<WH03027> of the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>: and thou shalt cause this city<WH05892> to be burned<WH08313><WTH8799> with fire<WH0784>. <RF>thou shalt cause...: Heb. thou shalt burn, etc<Rf>
Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> Zedekiah<WH06667> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, Let no man<WH0376> know<WH03045><WTH8799> of these words<WH01697>, and thou shalt not die<WH04191><WTH8799>.

But if the princes<WH08269> hear<WH08085><WTH8799> that I have talked<WH01696><WTH8765> with thee, and they come<WH0935><WTH8804> unto thee, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto thee, Declare<WH05046><WTH8685> unto us now what thou hast said<WH01696><WTH8765> unto the king<WH04428>, hide<WH03582><WTH8762> it not from us, and we will not put thee to death<WH04191><WTH8686>; also what the king<WH04428> said<WH01696><WTH8765> unto thee:

Then thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, I presented<WH05307><WTH8688> my supplication<WH08467> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428>, that he would not cause me to return<WH07725><WTH8687> to Jonathan's<WH03083> house<WH01004>, to die<WH04191><WTH8800> there.

Then came<WH0935><WTH8799> all the princes<WH08269> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, and asked<WH07592><WTH8799> him: and he told<WH05046><WTH8686> them according to all these words<WH01697> that the king<WH04428> had commanded<WH06680><WTH8765>. So they left off speaking<WH02790><WTH8686> with him; for the matter<WH01697> was not perceived<WH08085><WTH8738>. <RF>they...: Heb. they were silent from him<Rf>

So Jeremiah<WH03414> abode<WH03427><WTH8799> in the court<WH02691> of the prison<WH04307> until the day<WH03117> that Jerusalem<WH03389> was taken<WH03920><WTH8738>: and he was <FI>there<Fi> when Jerusalem<WH03389> was taken<WH03920><WTH8738>.<CM>
